Hana (Finance): NimbusData opened a billing ticket — they show a 95k embed spike for 2026-05-10 02:00-03:00 UTC. Asking for reconciliation and refund.
Leo (Eng-Infra): share the ledger extract you pulled?
Hana (Finance): quick pull from ledger:
```
2026-05-10T02:00Z, 189200
2026-05-10T03:00Z, 14,500
```
Their normal is ~90-100k/hr.
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy: proxy-gateway v4.2 in eu-central-1 at 2026-05-10T01:59:50Z by leo.deploy
Sofia (Eng-SRE): logs show gateway sent duplicate batches when a downstream circuit-breaker tripped during restart. Example lines:
```
[2026-05-10T02:00:03Z] proxy-gw-3 INFO batch_id=q1w2e3 sent=2048
[2026-05-10T02:00:03Z] ingest-2 ERROR batch_id=q1w2e3 circuit-breaker-reset; will retry
[2026-05-10T02:00:04Z] proxy-gw-3 INFO batch_id=q1w2e3 sent=2048
```
Sofia (Eng-SRE): checksum counts: unique embed rows = 94,600 but ledger shows 189,200 -> exact 2x duplication.
Leo (Eng-Infra): root cause: circuit-breaker reset caused the gateway to retry the same batch without checking idempotency key. Fix: add idempotency enforcement and prevent retry path on graceful restarts.
Sofia (Eng-SRE): will run dedupe backfill against ingestion ledger and pause the affected hour export. ETA 90 minutes to run and validate.
Hana (Finance): provisional overcount = 189,200 - 94,600 = 94,600 units. Contracted rate for NimbusData = $0.0042/unit. Raw credit = 94,600 * 0.0042 = $397.32.
Ellen (Finance-Lead): approve provisional credit up to $420. Please include ops RCA and incident link on the memo.
Tariq (Support): I'll update customer: "Investigating an ingestion duplication due to a gateway retry behavior during a restart; we'll reconcile and follow up with a credit estimate."
Sofia (Eng-SRE): backfill complete. Ledger corrected to 94,602 unique units; prior recorded 189,202. Delta 94,600.
Hana (Finance): final credit calculation: 94,600 units @ $0.0042 = $397.32. Rounding to $397.32.
Hana (Finance): Draft customer message: "We identified duplicated embed ingestion during a gateway restart which overstated your embed usage between 02:00-02:05 UTC on 2026-05-10. We corrected the ledger and issued a $397.32 credit. We've deployed a fix to prevent duplicate sends during restarts and added monitoring to alert on high duplicate rates."
Ellen (Finance-Lead): signed off. Apply operational credit, non-recurring, link INC-2026-678. Leave note for accounting to not count as revenue loss line item.
Leo (Eng-Infra): follow-up actions: merge patch to enforce idempotency key, add restart gating, and add synthetic test in CI to simulate circuit-breaker resets. Leaving a postmortem draft in #incidents.
Hana (Finance): credit applied and support notified. Closing loop once customer confirms on next invoice. :white_check_mark:
